newsitem.title: USA: NYSE suspends Acordia, seeks its delisting.
newsitem.headline: NYSE suspends Acordia, seeks its delisting.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday it would suspend trading in Acordia Inc shares immediately and seek the company's delisting.
The exchange said Acordia has fewer than 600,000 common shares held by the public as a result of a $40-a-share tender offer by Anthem Insurance Cos Inc that expired yesterday at midnight.
The exchange said it normally considers suspending and delisting issues when less than 600,000 shares are held by the public.

Anthem said Thursday it completed its tender offer, with 05 million Acordia shares tendered. The insurance brokerage firm said the tendered stock plus the 8.7 million shares it already held gives it about 98 percent of Acordia's outstanding shares.
